method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); six regulative rules (s 75(1)(a), s 92(1), s 93(1), s 93(3)-(4), s 87(1), s 87(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seat: the person with a claim on the estate of someone who died leaving property in New South Wales: a beneficiary under the will or on intestacy (legatee, devisee, dependant), a family member who wants the estate administered or the will proved, or a creditor of the person who died
